jobs.name: WreckScene
jobs.prompt: Using the attached image only as a STYLE and MOOD reference (chunky stylized low-poly game art, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, soft underwater light, a touch more realistic than a toy), paint a NEW underwater game environment, seen from a fish's eye height a little above the seabed. Copy the style only, not the layout. A ship graveyard in murky green-teal water. The hero: a huge old wooden galleon broken clean in two on the sand. The bow half lies on its side; the stern half stands tilted up, its carved captain's cabin windows glowing warm amber lantern light. The break opens the decks so a fish could swim through the hull. Fallen masts trail torn rigging nets. Heavy iron chains run across the sand from the wreck to a giant anchor. Bronze cannons spill from the gun deck; barrels and crates lie half buried. Behind, a toppled striped stone lighthouse lies across the seabed, and a rusty iron steamer and a small fishing trawler fade into the haze. Barnacles, a kelp fringe, small silver fish. Palette: dark wood, rust, bronze, teal, amber glow. No people, text, letters, numbers or watermark. No pale pink, peach or beige.
